pre_registered: 2026-10-08 (before any retrieval against the built corpus; committed to corpus-hub first)
authoring: BLIND from payload reads; needles chosen from the 29,240 payload files by era spread (2026 x3, 2020, 2019) and distinctive-function naming; every verbatim clause grep-verified in the payload file itself at authoring time; no retrieval was run against vuln-fix-commits before this file was committed

corpus_pin.payloads: 29,240 JSON files, 438MB, 24,025 distinct CVEs (8,849 from 2026, 1,723 pre-2016)

queries.q: chat template names written as jinja files path traversal outside the target directory
queries.expect: the huggingface/transformers fix for CVE-2026-9856 in top-5, template names like ../../foo flowing into os.path.join letting a saved repo write outside chat_template_dir
queries.verbatim: and lets a saved repo write a file outside the target

queries.q: SSRF external reference URL probe validate resolved IP address
queries.expect: the flowintel fix for CVE-2026-9813 in top-5, mitigating server-side request forgery in the external reference URL probe
queries.verbatim: Mitigate SSRF in external reference URL probe

queries.q: notification bell XSS innerHTML replaced with textContent DOM methods
queries.expect: the MISP/cti-transmute fix for CVE-2026-9806 in top-5, rebuilding notification items via DOM methods instead of innerHTML to stop XSS from malicious convert names
queries.verbatim: Rebuild notification items via DOM methods (textContent) instead of innerHTML

queries.q: MMU access rights check unaligned address range last page not checked
queries.expect: the OP-TEE fix for CVE-2019-1010293 in top-5, tee_mmu_check_access_rights missing the final page of a TA buffer when start and length are unaligned
queries.verbatim: the last page in the range is sometimes not checked

queries.q: stack buffer overflow yaffs filesystem stat time string buffer too small
queries.expect: the sleuthkit fix for CVE-2020-10232 in top-5, growing the yaffsfs_istat time buffer to what tsk_fs_time_to_str requires
queries.verbatim: increasing the buffer size to the size required by tsk_fs_time_to_str
